title: dlt Pipeline Run Duration p95
app: dlt (data load tool) pipeline trace and load-info events forwarded as JSON to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=dlt:load status="completed"
| eval dur_s=round(duration_s/1,2)
| stats avg(dur_s) as avg_s, p95(dur_s) as p95_s, count as runs by pipeline_name
| where p95_s>300
| sort - p95_s
description: Computes the 95th-percentile run duration for each pipeline in dlt and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking dlt pipelines by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest dlt timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest pipelines with their owners.
visualization: Table of pipeline by p95 run duration, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in dlt so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
